title: Jack Jenny
summary: Maxwell knew Jack Jenny's records and his wife Bonnie Lake, a friend of Artie's.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Did you know Jack Jenny, know anything about him?

No, I didn't know very much about him at all. I have one or two of his records and I know his solos by heart, a couple beautiful tunes. And I knew the woman he was married to, Bonnie Lake I knew very well. She was a good friend of my brother-in-law's, Artie's. In fact, I still see her from time to time.
